summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its routine Total Voting Rights notice dated 2 November 2026 under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. As at 30 October 2026, issued share capital comprised 2,525,131,460 ordinary shares of 1 pence each, one vote per share, with no shares held in treasury, so total voting rights equal 2,525,131,460. The figure serves as the denominator for shareholders' interest notifications under the DTRs. No transaction, terms, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is involved; purely administrative disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
